Having thoroughly reviewed the codebase, architectural blueprints (`JARVIS_ENDGAME.md`), operating protocols (`CLAUDE.md`), master roadmap, and historical knowledge base decisions, here is the breakdown of what this project is, how it is built, and what you are driving toward in the long term.

---

### 1. What Project JARVIS Actually Is

JARVIS is not a wrapper around commercial AI APIs or a generic coding assistant. It is a **private, hybrid-hosted "Model of Models" (MoM) Cognitive Orchestrator and Autonomous R&D Lab**, designed as a custom software system built from scratch in `jarvis_core/`:

*   **Memory Layer (`jarvis_core/memory/`):** A hybrid retrieval system combining local vector search (ChromaDB), lexical search (BM25), and cross-encoder reranking over your private data and an append-only Knowledge Base (`knowledge_base.jsonl`).
*   **Agent Framework (`jarvis_core/agent/`):** A custom, zero-dependency agent runtime featuring ReAct loops, DAG task planning, Pydantic tool call parsing, cost tracking, and MemGPT-style memory paging.
*   **Brain Orchestration (`jarvis_core/brain/`):** A dynamic intent router, budget governor, epistemic contradiction detector, and response aggregator routing queries to appropriate model targets.
*   **Domain Specialists (Stage 5 / `jarvis_core/specialists/`):** QLoRA domain adapters fine-tuned on top of a shared MoE base model (Kimi K2.6) trained specifically on your private codebase, engineering notes, and past domain history.
*   **Hearth / Integration (`serve/hearth.py` & Stage 6):** An always-on loopback service handling continuous background tasks, memory consolidation, and multi-surface IPC.

---
